text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Passing by the Miho Dormitory, I heard a noisy clamor coming from inside.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, gather 'round!
We've got specialties from all over the place~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, would you like to join, Trainer?
The Miho Dormitory Exhibition welcomes guests from outside the dorm as well!
choice_data_list: A Miho Dorm local product fair?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Yukino suggested it, and now it's a regular tradition at the Miho Dorm!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Care packages regularly arrive from the Miho girls' families for the whole dorm, but when it's meant for everyone, it really adds up to quite a lot.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: "Just as I was thinking what a waste it'd be to leave them, Yukino said, 'Then why don't we hold a local specialty fair?!'"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. There were specialties gathered from all over, and I figured if we let people from outside the dorm join in too, everyone could have fun together.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I used to help out with local specialty fairs back home,
so I thought I could be of some help!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
That was a huge help. We don't have leftover
souvenirs anymore, and everyone at the academy
says it feels like a festival!
choice_data_list: It looks interesting, maybe I'll go check it out.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Then you take a break too, Yukino!
We'll handle the event staff duties here,
so go ahead and check out the booths together for a bit!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Are ya really sure!?
Thank ya kindly, gansu!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oho, welcome! We've got downtown's famous
dorayaki, and even seven-spice chili pepper
for cooking!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
All of these Japanese sweets look like they'd go great with green tea.
May I have one of each?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El will take the chili peppers!
I wanna try a different kind of spicy from salsa vida, deeeeesu!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Bitter melon, is it...? I'd like to use it as an ingredient for medicinal cuisine. May I take a few?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Wah! This Shisa keychain
is so cute! It comes as a pair, so
maybe I should get one for Maruzen-san too~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I'm sure they will be very pleased.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
A glass wind chime...
What a wonderful souvenir that lets you feel the breeze.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Turbo wants this keychain!
I saw a giant version of this in Fukushima!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
That is a streamer.
It's a famous Tanabata decoration.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I'm glad everyone looked so happy this time too~.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...The atmosphere at local product fairs really is the best.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"It made me realize all over again how wonderful my hometown is,
and learning about other girls' hometowns made my heart feel so warm..."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
All the care packages sent to Tracen Academy
were overflowing with so much love—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "Seeing everyone getting all warm and cozy through the local specialties fair makes me so happy!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad I worked up the courage to suggest that to Hishi Ama-san back then~.
choice_data_list: Let's go all out and hit every booth! Time to have some fun!
Let's go all out and have fun visiting the booths too!
I can really feel your strong love for your hometown!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad I worked up the courage to suggest that to Hishi Ama-san back then~.
choice_data_list: Let's go all out and hit every booth! Time to have some fun!
Let's go all out and have fun visiting the booths too!
I can really feel your strong love for your hometown!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Right!
Ah, the Morioka booth is nearby, so let me invite you over!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
The classic choice is super-crispy rice crackers,
but dango with sweet black sesame filling is delicious too~

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
And then there's the Morioka Big Three Noodles!
We don't have wanko soba this time, but you can try the other two over there!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Back home, my whole family used to eat this together on hot days too. Ah, brings back memories~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even though it was break time, Yukino Bijin was running around
the booth, enthusiastically introducing goods from her hometown.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Feeling the deep love she holds for her hometown,
I thoroughly enjoyed the local specialty fair.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes! Every single booth looks wonderful, so I don't know where to look~.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I know! Someday, I'd love to go on a tour around your hometown, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It's my Trainer's hometown, after all,
so I'm sure it's nothin' but a wonderful place!
choice_data_list: I'll show you around if I get the chance!
I'll show you around if I get the chance, okay?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yay! We'll probably go all over the place, so I gotta build up my arm strength to carry back lots of souvenirs!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Yukino Bijin so fired up
was truly heartwarming.
